purpose: Durable input-only atomization decision, required coordinate-labelled line drawing, continuous saved-surface comparison, and exact inherited-seam closure proof for a three-placement compact fan extraction. Execution and fresh native-DAT verification belong to the separate atomization/integration record.

decision.core_name: HSR Level 2 Compact Paired Fan Core
decision.straight_name: HSR Level 2 Paired Straight with Recessed Web
decision.rejection_reason: Its exposed structural web extends approximately 36.949 millimetres farther from the centre on each side; the three earlier horizontal flange/border heights and identical PATH geometry did not establish full-body equivalence.

drawing.kind: Measured input and extraction plan; fixed analysis labels; no manual or game status
drawing.source: All eleven actual saved full-fan tile PATH resources; arrows follow actual PATH sample points; supports and structural cells follow the frozen source.

outer_solid_method.ray_direction: positive east at fixed saved-model height and south coordinate
outer_solid_method.height_sampling: Every actual unique vertex height from both straight tiles, that height±0.1 mm, and midpoints between distinct height bands wider than 0.04 mm. Exact-height degeneracies are retained diagnostically but continuous saved-face coverage controls geometric agreement.

encoding_and_texture_limits.explanation: The repeated canonical interior tile retains its exact 365 encoded triangles. Replacing row0 also changes triangulation and whole-repeat UV phases. Non-cap geometry is mutually covered continuously within the original 20 micrometre check; the 26 support triangles and raw material bytes are exact. Ten atlas-different seam slivers total 1.9073486043907906e-6 square metres and are at most 0.476837158203125 micrometres wide. Fourteen redundant original northern caps are removed explicitly.

retained_core_to_straight_join.scope: Continuous comparison of all actual retained fork north-collar surfaces, not only horizontal flange sections or PATHs. No source mutation.

existing_external_north_join.scope: Actual saved native-neighbour south end-plane faces, continuously covering every removed original fan north end cap; no authoring or model mutation.
existing_external_north_join.preservation_note: The accepted native neighbour already carries opposite-facing complete cap surfaces. Removing the original fan’s redundant north-facing cap leaves the actual native south-facing cover in place, including the inherited recessed-web transition; repeated canonical interior straights introduce no end fins.

full_solid_cross_section_comparison.scope: This exposed structural-web step predates extraction. The immutable native neighbour closes it with the actual end-plane triangles listed above. It is an inherited transition, not general proof that ordinary native paired profiles are equal to the recessed-web profile.

limitations: This is a saved-resource geometry and authoring decision. No human image approval, in-game appearance, Route Query, visible train travel, installation, or publication is inferred.
Original full-fan artwork and evidence remain byte-identical. The diagram is an additional input-only assembly analysis view, not a refreshed Trumpet model picture.
Final new-core and new-straight resource proofs and the complete 28-placement assembly audit are separate gates before any Trumpet model rendering.

measurement_replay.default_scope: Replays continuous closure coverage from the exact embedded saved triangles; does not claim that original DATs were loaded.
measurement_replay.actual_full_replay_scope: Actual pinned parent and native-neighbour DAT verification.

actual_full_replay_results.scope: Actual pinned parent and native-neighbour DAT verification.
